decisions.reason: The multi-model formwork profile line sits at the core of the firm's offer and had its own page, so having invested in it and committed to it publicly, management persists even though it was not observed on the website in 2020 to 2021.

Automated distributor flow control embodies the announced automation strategy and in-house R&D, so its centrality justifies keeping it despite low visibility, with weak results put down to the construction cycle and pandemic disruptions.
The shuttering magnet line is a cheap extension of the established magnetic formwork range, and dropping it would bring little relief while undermining the integrated system the firm promotes.
Magnetic formwork strips are a multi-model line with a dedicated page and fit the firm's core business, so the firm defends this visible commitment.

Having already withdrawn the similar Product F, management treats E as the surviving magnetic component that justifies the earlier investment, though its overlap with the broader range keeps the risk somewhat elevated.
